武器（任意劍），極珍稀（需同調）
這件武器看上去很普通，但其中蘊藏着的強大幻術可以讓使用者巧妙地迷惑對手。你使用這件魔法武器進行的攻擊檢定和傷害擲骰獲得+2加值。你持握這把劍期間，獲得以下增益：
愚者佯攻Fool’s Feint。以一個附贈動作，你可以選擇一個距離你5尺以內的生物作爲你的目標發動佯攻。直到你的下一個回合開始爲止，你對目標的攻擊檢定具有優勢。此附贈動作一經使用，直到下次黎明前不能再次使用。
轉向Misdirect。當距你60尺內的一個生物以你爲目標進行一次攻擊檢定時，你可以用一個反應迫使該生物進行一次[[/save ability=int dc=15]]豁免。若其豁免失敗，則此次攻擊會改爲以攻擊者觸及內的你選擇的另一個生物爲目標。此反應一經使用，直到下次黎明前不能再次使用。

This weapon appears ordinary, but it bears strong illusion magic that allows its wielder to skillfully deceive opponents.

You have a +2 bonus to attack and damage rolls made with this magic weapon. While wielding it, you also gain the following benefits:

  • Fool's Feint. As a bonus action, you can feint, choosing a creature within 5 feet of you as your target. Until the start of your next turn, you have advantage on attack rolls against the target. Once this bonus action is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

  • Misdirect. When a creature within 60 feet of you targets you with an attack roll, you can use your reaction to require that creature to make a [[/save ability=int dc=15]] saving throw. On a failed save, the attack instead targets another creature of your choice that is within the attacker's reach. Once this reaction has been used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

Base items. This item variant can be applied to the following base items:

  • @item[Double-Bladed Scimitar|ERLW] (@item[Fool's Double-Bladed Scimitar|BMT])
  • @item[Greatsword|PHB] (@item[Fool's Greatsword|BMT])
  • @item[Longsword|PHB] (@item[Fool's Longsword|BMT])
  • @item[Rapier|PHB] (@item[Fool's Rapier|BMT])
  • @item[Scimitar|PHB] (@item[Fool's Scimitar|BMT])
  • @item[Shortsword|PHB] (@item[Fool's Shortsword|BMT])
